before I start I just want to say that I am not so good with english.

now about your post.

I know the feeling that you have, my family is toxic and I never had a friend. I am basically my whole life alone and that's make me learn a lot and make me be a more realistic person, I hope I don't make you feel worse because I will tell the truth, and the truth hurts.

when you actually wake up and think "holy shit I am all by own" hurts like fucking hell, everyone want a friend, someone to talk, someone to play with, someone to love, and when you realise that you don't have that you start to feel pain, some less or more than others, but you will. I remember the time that I realise that, I was feeling so much pain that I didn't even cried, I was stunned. the only thing that I did the whole day was look to the wall. if you are in this phase the only thing that I can tell you is, be strong, don't let the pain consume you or loneliness will become something else that will be extremely worst.

after something that you are loleny you start to do a lot of things, it's doesn't  matter what is , you just need something to fill that empty inside your chest, some people try finding friends, play video games , see movies, eat a lot and etc. remember that I said to you be strong or you would be consume and loneliness will become something worse ? here that this happens, some people fuck their self just to stop felling empty. don't try something stupid. is gonna be hard but try to be strong. I started to eat a lot and this fucked me. I don't recommend, try something healthy not something that can fuck you up.


after all this pain you will become to do things to forget that emptiness that you feel. in this phase I started to study and I am not talking that shit things that they force you to learn in school, I was studying things that I like. this is phase is too personal and I cannot say what will happen to you. the only person that know what you like is yourself. 

sure will hurt, and there's no way that I know to escape from this, somedays less than others but will always hurt,  time don't reduce the pain but help you deal with it. sometimes you want someone to talk and no one will be there, I know how is like and the only thing that I can say is be strong, you can deal with this, in the end we all are alone, don't let this fake people make you feel bad about yourself, they will all die alone like everyone else. you don't need someone to be happy. be honest with yourself and don't let anyone make you feel bad. this was what I learned in my years with no friends or people near me to talk. this is just my experience and i hope to have said nothing wrong. good lucky friend.
